pages.title: Bush Dog
pages.text: The bush dog ($(o)Speothos venaticus$()) is a small canid found in the forests and wet savannas of Central and South America, from Panama to northern Argentina.$(br2)It has a stocky body, short legs, a short tail and small rounded ears. Its partly webbed feet make it a strong swimmer.$(br2)Bush dogs live and hunt in packs, taking prey such as pacas and agoutis.
